comment: The apply_note_change argument object every client sends: the 16-argument overload, the 14 note fields plus p_attachment_ids and p_wipe_generation. p_attachment_ids names exactly the uploaded (r2:) attachments the version references (none here; pending: images have no server row yet). p_wipe_generation is 0 for an account that has never had its cloud data deleted. restore_note takes the 14 note fields plus p_wipe_generation, without p_attachment_ids. Key names and value types are the contract; p_base_revision is null on a note the server has never seen. Whether each client's argument set matches a deployed signature is checked against supabase/migrations by RpcSignatureContractTest (Kotlin) and rpcSignatureContract.test.ts (web).
